name: tradesync
description: TradeSync - BSE trade synchronization dashboard (MERN, BullMQ, SSE)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n exchange,api,worker,client -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:exchange -w server" "npm run dev:api -w server" "npm run dev:worker -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
